result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B fixes the issues that matter in use: it drops the gradient, drop shadow and hairline outline with clear reasons, and makes the route line and hold readable. Both answers keep Papyrus. A only swaps the fantasy fallback, while B explains why Papyrus is weak but leaves it alone. A mostly tweaks the shadow and gradient, keeps them, and never considers one-color or small-size use. B at least names those as missing versions it can add. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers keep the mountain and the Boulderline name, and both give revised SVG. A fixes the problems that would show up in real use: it removes the gradient, drop shadow and outline stroke, thickens the route line, and enlarges and darkens the tagline, with a reason for each. B mostly adjusts those same effects and keeps them. Neither answer replaces Papyrus. Only A comes partway to a version that works in a single solid color, and it admits there are no one-color or small-size versions yet.
